# draht

> draht is an open source (MIT) AI coding agent for the terminal, published on npm as @draht/coding-agent. It is a fork of the pi coding agent by Mario Zechner, as are @draht/router and @draht/chord.

- Run: `npx @draht/coding-agent`, or `npm install -g @draht/coding-agent` then `draht`
- Auth: API keys (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) or `/login` with Claude Pro/Max, ChatGPT Plus/Pro (Codex), GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Antigravity
- Default tools: read, write, edit, bash
- Features: duet mode, Polyphase workflows, RLM (`draht rlm` for inputs larger than the context window), codemode, specialist subagents, virtual models, session tree, MCP servers, extensions, skills, prompt templates, themes, SDK and RPC mode
- Opinionated prompts: slash commands such as /new-project, /plan-phase, /execute-phase, /verify-work, /fix, /review, /orchestrate; optional skills tdd-workflow, ddd-workflow, gsd-workflow (TDD, DDD and GSD are all optional), shipped in the npm package and in the plugins
- Plugins: `npx draht-claude install` (Claude Code), `npx draht-codex install` (Codex)
- License: MIT
